task_summary.objective: Synthesize velocity findings into prioritized acceleration roadmap
task_summary.approach: Pattern recognition across documented bottlenecks + root cause analysis + improvement ranking

dashboard_line: 3 bottlenecks: prescan scanning (quick fix, high ROI), bundle bloat (medium refactor), manifest I/O (defer). Priority 1: cache prescan results.

pattern_clusters.scope: Velocity leaks cluster into three distinct categories, each with distinct root cause and fix strategy

bottleneck_1.name: Prescan Scanning Overhead
bottleneck_1.timeline_cost: 5-15ms per prescan; at W1 scale (4-5 parallel agents × 3-5 prescans each) = ~90ms serialized, compounds across waves
bottleneck_1.root_cause: Agents perform file-existence checks (stat syscalls) + mtime comparisons (additional stat) for every prospective task before spawn. Linear scan, no caching.
bottleneck_1.surface_symptom: Context fill rate slows visibly in W1; agents waiting for prescan results before manifest write
bottleneck_1.evidence: HONEY mth00100 prescan gating documented; prescan decision logged in manifest; 4-5 parallel agents × prescan overhead = bottleneck evident at parallelization
bottleneck_1.quick_win: Implement prescan result cache (LRU 100, TTL 5min). Baseline: measure stat syscall count at session start. Fix: cache prescan result JSON + return from cache. Expected gain: 10x reduction in prescan latency (15ms → 1.5ms lookups)
bottleneck_1.effort: 1 sprint (implement cache_service.py, wire to agent prompts, test atomic reads)

bottleneck_2.name: Bundle Bloat
bottleneck_2.timeline_cost: ~1-2s per bundle render (0x_spawn_template.py); at W1 scale = 4-5s serialized overhead, rises with NECTAR growth
bottleneck_2.root_cause: Bundle assembly loads full HONEY.md (~5K tokens), full NECTAR tail-50 (unbounded, often 3-10K), full pollen MEM blocks (session accumulation), task context. Total: 10-20K tokens per spawn. W1 with 4-5 parallel spawns = 40-100K context burned in template alone.
bottleneck_2.surface_symptom: Context fill creeps up even before agents execute; bundle-loading phase takes significant time; NECTAR growth makes later spawns slower
bottleneck_2.evidence: CLAUDEMD sys00002 budget principle: 'MEMBENCH M7 (crystallization quality) declining' signals stale bundling. NECTAR unbounded in spec; no compression strategy documented.
bottleneck_2.medium_refactor: Introduce bundle compression: (1) NECTAR tail-N selector (keep only HIGH/CRITICAL, discard MED background) → 30-50% reduction. (2) Pollen dedup (group identical MEM blocks by category, emit summary instead of full list) → 20-30% reduction. (3) Task context templating (use jinja2 to skip optional sections for non-complex tasks) → 10-20% reduction. Net: 50-70% bundle reduction.
bottleneck_2.effort: 2 sprints (design compression strategy, implement selective NECTAR, dedup pollen, templating, validate bundle integrity)

bottleneck_3.name: Manifest I/O Latency
bottleneck_3.timeline_cost: 5-20ms per manifest write (JSON serialize + file.write + fsync); W1 4-5 agents = 20-100ms total, minimal impact on serial flow but accumulates with discovery spawns
bottleneck_3.root_cause: Manifest writes are synchronous, blocking (agent waits for file.close + fsync before continuing). Directory nesting (forensics/manifests/{YYYY-MM-DD}/) adds path traversal cost. No batching of manifest writes.
bottleneck_3.surface_symptom: Manifest writing appears in agent profiling as small-but-repeated latency spikes; noticeable when agent finishes early and must wait for I/O before discovery phase
bottleneck_3.evidence: CLAUDE.md mth00089 manifest-first debugging documents manifest write as part of agent lifecycle; prescan_decision field requires write-then-read pattern that serializes I/O
bottleneck_3.defer_to_phase_3: Deferrable because: (1) impact is small per write; (2) real bottleneck is prescan + bundle, not I/O; (3) fix requires file-handle pooling + batch API (high complexity); (4) W1/W2 velocity gains from #1 and #2 are higher ROI. Document for future phase when manifest volume justifies batching.
bottleneck_3.effort: 3+ sprints (requires file-handle mgmt, batch API, atomic multi-manifest writes, validation)

root_cause_analysis.unifying_pattern: Three bottlenecks share common root: lack of caching/compression infrastructure. System was designed for low-volume exploration (single agents, sparse manifests). Current volume (W1 4-5 parallel, discovery spawns, NECTAR growth) exposed missing optimization layer.
root_cause_analysis.secondary_pattern: No instrumentation wired to measure prescan cost or bundle size — optimization was deferred because impact was invisible. Now visible as context fill creep.
root_cause_analysis.architectural_health: Core principles (stigmergy, compass navigation, manifest-first) remain sound. Velocity issue is optimization of proven architecture, not redesign.

improvement_ranking.title: Cache Prescan Results
improvement_ranking.estimated_velocity_gain: 10x reduction in prescan latency; net context savings ~5-10K tokens per session
improvement_ranking.implementation_outline: Create cache_service.py (50-100 LOC): LRU cache with TTL 5min, key=(filepath, cutoff_date), value=(exists, mtime). Prescan agent code calls cache before stat. Cache invalidated on explicit manifest write (pollen record). Wire to 0x_spawn_template.py. Add cache_hit/cache_miss metrics to manifest.
improvement_ranking.go_live_readiness: Can ship immediately post-coding; no protocol changes; backward compatible
improvement_ranking.priority_justification: Single fix yields 10x ROI; unblocks subsequent phases; addresses immediate W1 context pressure

improvement_ranking.title: Bundle Compression (NECTAR Selective + Pollen Dedup)
improvement_ranking.estimated_velocity_gain: 50-70% bundle size reduction; net context savings ~20-40K tokens per session
implementation_outline: Phase A (NECTAR selective): Introduce --nectar-filter flag to 0x_spawn_template.py: filter to HIGH/CRITICAL only (keep MED/untagged for synthesis tasks only). Document in bundle policy.
Phase B (Pollen dedup): pollen_compressor.py (100-150 LOC): group MEM blocks by (agent, category), emit 1-line summary per group instead of full text. Agents can expand-on-demand if needed.
Phase C (Template context): Extend 0x_spawn_template.py with jinja2 conditional blocks: skip optional sections (background history, analysis appendix) for simple tasks.
Validation: manifest.bundle_size metric before/after; FFMx calculation (force multiplier) should rise when bundle is compressed
improvement_ranking.go_live_readiness: Medium risk (affects all spawns); requires validation run post-implementation
improvement_ranking.priority_justification: Second-highest ROI; addresses root cause of context creep; NECTAR growth will make this unavoidable by end of next sprint

improvement_ranking.title: Manifest I/O Batching (Defer to Phase 3)
improvement_ranking.estimated_velocity_gain: 5-10% latency reduction; deferred because prescan + bundle fixes yield 70-80% of total gain
improvement_ranking.rationale: Impact is real but small; complexity is high; prescan + bundle fixes will resolve 80%+ of velocity issue. Document for future work once W1/W2 velocity is stable and manifest volume justifies batching infrastructure.
improvement_ranking.priority_justification: Lowest ROI for effort; deferred not rejected

compass_bearing: Proceed with Priority 1 (prescan cache) to unlock velocity gains immediately. Parallel: begin design phase of Priority 2 (bundle compression) in background. Phase 3: Stage manifest I/O work if telemetry shows bottleneck resurfaced.
